meta.g6_holdout_note: G6 (Oct22-Nov4) is the FIRST TRUE blind holdout scored on s95.1. Roll-adjusted, G6 was a V: week-1 give-back DOWN (3.52->3.14) then week-2 recovery UP (->3.66), net +0.14. The forecast leaned down (reversion lean) and: (a) CAUGHT the week-1 give-back DIRECTION (cross_block_reversion earned week-1); (b) MISSED the week-2 recovery - the intra-block turn / counter-trend recovery, the OPEN problem, still unsolved (same failure mode as 0916); (c) MAGNITUDE was the DOMINANT error (undersized both the dip and the recovery); (d) the storage SURPLUS (bearish) got the block direction WRONG - winter heating-demand (HDD rising) won. LESSONS FOLDED: cross_block_reversion is a GIVE-BACK, not a sustained reversal (a block can V back - as G5 and G6 both did); fundamentals are NOT even a reliable block-direction cue near the winter transition (rising HDD flips the sign); magnitude remains the dominant residual; the intra-block counter-trend turn is the top open problem.

meta.s96_2_refine_note: S96.2 UNBLINDED per-group refine of G7 (Nov5-18, first winter block) - ITERATIVE (Greg S96): refined curves written into forecasts/grp7.json (refined_* fields), derived ONLY from general rules + decision-state + prior-day ACTUAL tape (never the forecast day's own tape). NEW/CHANGED RULES (each n>=2 spanning groups): (R1) GIVE-BACK-EXHAUSTION DAY-BOUNDARY READ - new play direction.giveback_exhaustion_boundary: a give-back day that closes >=~40-50% off its intraday extreme with a last-hours counter-tick, while the underlying swing's big legs show no continuation-collapse -> give-back EXHAUSTED, swing resumes next session (1105->1106, 1107->1109 gap, 1110->1111, 1112->1113 G7; 0926->0929, 1003->1005 G4); a give-back that closes AT its extreme with last hours extending CONTINUES (1002->1003 G4, 1114->1117 G7); if the swing side's own legs already collapsed, stand down (0915 down-legs 0/8 -> the 0916 counter-grind correctly filtered). THIS is the day-level SEQUENCING answer: the carrier day (1111 not 1110) is pinned by the boundary read off day-N-1 actuals. (R2) STORAGE-THURSDAY SIDE = RUNNING SWING/TURN STATE, NEVER THE PRINT SIGN - reframed into daytype.storage_thursday_magnitude: 10 storage Thursdays across G3-G7 all sided with the swing (or the just-armed turn: 0925, 1030), zero with the surprise sign when they disagreed (1106 +1350 THROUGH +10.8-above; 1113 +620 THROUGH +5.2-above). (R3) WEEKEND-GAP DELIVERY + MONDAY GAP-REACTION - reframed into daytype.monday_weekend_gap: the weekend repricing is delivered at the SUNDAY reopen gap; Monday's US session is the REACTION: gap WITH a mature swing to a fresh extreme is FADED (1109+1560->1110 -820; 0908 mild), gap at a FRESH turn is EXTENDED (1019->1020 +2660); with no material gap Monday carries Friday's side (1107->1110, 1114->1117, 0919->0922, 1017->1020). Monday-as-block-reversal is DEAD - it was swing-state coincidence. (R4) MATURE-SWING ALTERNATION - new play structure.mature_swing_alternation: a young swing (<=3 sessions from the turn) chains extensions (0929-1001 G4; 1030-1104 G6); a mature swing (>=4 sessions) never extends a material fresh extreme close - next session is a give-back/hold (G7 5/5; 1007->1008 G4). (R5) GIVE-BACK ORIGIN-SHELF FLOOR - new play level.giveback_origin_shelf: a terminal give-back runs to the swing's origin shelf then stabilizes; at >=~75% retrace the R1 closes-at-low read INVERTS (capitulation precedes the bounce: 0922->0923, 1016->1017, 1117->1118). REFINED-vs-ACTUAL (per-event): 1105 -500/-520, 1106 +1400/+1350, 1107 -650/-720, 1110 -800/-820 (weekend gap +1200/+1560), 1111 +1400/+1580, 1112 -100/+100 (sign miss, hold-day), 1113 +800/+620, 1114 -900/-910, 1117 -1400/-1500, 1118 +250/+270. IRREDUCIBLE at the open: (a) the hold-day sign inside +-150 (1112); (b) the EXTREME magnitudes (1111 +1580 on a thin holiday - direction+size-up callable, full size not; the standing dominant residual); (c) the Sunday-gap SIZE (1109 +1560 - direction callable via R1, magnitude not); (d) the R5 bounce-day timing rests on a soft >=75%-retrace threshold (n=3). GUARD: rules were applied UNIFORMLY across the block and back-checked on G3-6; sizes come from condition-class bands (mature-swing give-back -500..-900; catalyst resume +800..+1400), never from the target day's tape.

meta.s97_2_refine_note: S97.2 UNBLINDED per-group refine of G8 (Nov19-Dec2, deep winter onset) - refined curves in forecasts/grp8.json (refined_* fields), derived ONLY from general rules + decision-state + prior-day ACTUAL tape; sizes from condition-class bands, never the target day's tape. THE HEADLINE: the whole block is ONE ALTERNATION CHAIN (extension 1119 / give-back 1120 / resume 1121 / holds 1124+1127 / lull give-back 1125 / resume 1126 / melt-up 1128 / SUNDAY give-back 1130 / resume 1201 / crest give-back 1202) - scheduled catalysts do NOT re-anchor the chain; the chain state off day-N-1 tape owns every day's NET. RESOLUTIONS (each n>=2 spanning groups): (P1) PHASE SHIFT = CATALYST CONTINUITY - new play timing.catalyst_continuity_frontrun: under a LIVE continuous weather catalyst (hard_heat ramp visible in the models) an armed turn/resume fires the NEXT session, front-running the discrete print/peak (1110exh->1111 G7, 1118armed->1119 G8); with no live ramp the resume WAITS for the discrete catalyst (0923->0924 hold->0925 Thu G3/4; 1029 stall->1030 Thu G6). The 1119/1120 and 1201/1202 'inversions' were chain-phase slips in one-shot mode, not rule failures: run off actual tape the chain pins 1120 as post-violent give-back and 1202 as the give-back off the 1201 extreme. (P2) RULE PRECEDENCE (1120): R2 was never a day-NET rule - R2 owns the post-print LEG side + the magnitude up-size; the day NET is owned by the chain (R1/R4). A print day after a violent prior-day extension pops WITH the swing and ROUND-TRIPS into an alternation give-back close (1001->1002 +900spike/-440close G4; 1119->1120 pop/-730 G8). All 12 storage Thursdays G3-G8 are consistent under this frame (11 leg-sided with the swing; 1120 leg-sided too). (P3) WINTER MAGNITUDE BANDS (live-cold-ramp regime, per-event): resume +1300..+2000 (1111 +1580, 1119 +1930, 1126 +1360); thin-holiday+hard_heat+delivery MELT-UP stack +1600..+2400 (1111, 1128 +2340 - thin AMPLIFIES a delivery day, early close does NOT cap); give-back splits by weather state: ramp-live/crest SHALLOW -700..-900 (1110, 1120, 1202) vs LULL (HDD flat/falling that day) DEEP -1500..-1800 (1117, 1125 -1770); non-catalyst resume stays +800..+1000 (0925, 0929, 1121, 1201); holds stay +-150 even in winter (0924, 1112, 1124, 1127). (P4) 1128 folded: thin+hard_heat+print = melt-up stack n=2 (1111, 1128); thin is an AMPLIFIER on delivery days, a damper on hold days (1013, 1127). (P5) 1124 solved: the weekend gap carries only NEW closure info - a shock already in the models (priced 1119-1121) adds ~nothing over the weekend (1123-24 ~+250, and the +390 Sunday jump was the Dec->Jan ROLL) vs 1109 +1560 when the shock was new that weekend; also the chain runs THROUGH Sunday sessions (1130 -590 took the post-1128 give-back, so 1201 opened resume-due). R1 REFINEMENTS: ramp arm - under a live ramp with intact swing legs a one-day give-back resumes regardless of close-recovery fraction (1120->1121 25%, 1125->1126 14%; 1110->1111 consistent); depth arm - at >=~70% swing retrace R5 capitulation OUTRANKS the R1 closes-at-low continuation read (0922->0923, 1016->1017, 1117->1118, 1125->1126). REFINED-vs-ACTUAL (per-event): 1119 +1600/+1930, 1120 -700/-730, 1121 +900/+910, 1124 +100/+80, 1125 -1600/-1770, 1126 +1400/+1360, 1127 +100/+160, 1128 +2000/+2340, 1201 +900/+890, 1202 -800/-710. Direction 10/10. IRREDUCIBLE: (a) extreme-day full magnitude (1119 +1930 vs band-high +1600; 1128 +2340 vs +2000) - the standing dominant residual; (b) hold-day sign inside +-150 (1124, 1127); (c) Sunday-session depth (1130 -590; thin-session R1 reads unreliable); (d) the one-shot chain PHASE itself - one violent surprise (1119) shifts the whole chain a day; only day-N-1 tape re-anchors it (the live-coach argument). meta.s98_2_refine_note: S98.2 UNBLINDED per-group refine of G9 (Dec3-31, the surplus-collapse block, the walk's FIRST BLOCK-LEAN MISS) - refined curves in forecasts/grp9.json (refined_* fields), derived ONLY from general rules + decision-state + prior-day ACTUAL tape; sizes from condition-class bands. THE HEADLINE: the block-lean killer is SOLVED as a GENERAL play - structure.chain_polarity_flip: (ARM, read at a swing-day close) PARABOLIC EXTENSION (run >=~1.5-2x the season's prior largest swing, >=~9 sessions, no origin-shelf touch: G9 +9700/12 sessions vs prior winter swings <=+5080; G4 +3690 = 1.6x G3; G5 -3770 = 1.7x) + BLOW-OFF (the extension day closes >=~30% off its intraday extreme: 1205 closed 31% off +3560; 1007 last-hour roll-over; mirror 1222 closed 72% off its low); (CONFIRM) the FIRST BAND-BREAKING counter day (net >=~1.5x its condition-class give-back band: 1208 -2730 vs -700..-900 = 3x; 1008 -1800; 1020 +2660; 1223 +5010) WITH old-direction continuation-collapse (1208 up-legs 3/33; 1008 up 0/15; 1020 down 1/10) - a weekend repricing AGAINST the armed crest counts as the counter delivery (1207 Sun gap -2380). After CONFIRM every polarity-relative rule (R1 resume, ramp arm, alternation, print side) reads in the NEW direction, and R5's origin shelf is VOID (1211 broke the 4.367 origin - post-parabolic it is a REVERSAL, not a give-back; contrast G7's non-parabolic give-back, 0.55x prior swing, which held its shelf and resumed). Back-checks: tops 1007/1008 (autumn) + 1205/1208 (winter); bottoms 1016->1019/1020 (autumn) + 1222/1223 (winter, terminated-to-BASING - the year-end caveat: no new lows after 1223 but no clean up-chain either). OTHER RESOLUTIONS: (1) FUNDAMENTAL INVERSION dissolves into ONE rule - prints NEVER own the side, the chain at its CURRENT POLARITY does (up-chain bought bearish prints 1106/1113/1128; down-chain sold bullish prints 1023/1211/1218/1224); at a priced parabolic extreme 1-3 sessions post-flip the confirming print is the EXIT-LIQUIDITY event (-1800..-4000: 1211 -3970). (2) THE 1204 CONTRA: a post-violent print day gives back only when the ramp crested at/before the print (1120, 1202, 1002); with the HDD stream still RISING through the print (26.9->30.3->30.5) the give-back lands INTRADAY and the catalyst wins the close (1204 +1100, morning -390). (3) THE SYMMETRIC BOUNDARY READ: R1 generalizes to EVERY session - close AT the extreme (<~10% recovery) -> chain continues (1208->1209, 1211->1212, 1212->1215, 1215->1216; miss 1209->1210 +370); close >=~35% off the extreme with a late counter-tick -> one-day alternation bounce (1216->1217 +1880, 1218->1219 +850, 1222->1223 +5010). (4) BOUNCES ARE NEVER EXTENDED in a mature chain - and a scheduled print following a violent counter-bounce delivers OLD-chain-side through it (1023, 1218, 1224 = the attack-6 verdict: chain polarity beats the young turn, n=3). (5) FAILED-RALLY TELL: a counter-chain spike that round-trips (1210 65%, 1230 91%) -> next session runs hard chain-side (1211 -3970, 1231 -2630; mirror 1002->1003). (6) CREST/CRASH BANDS set (see magnitude.crash_regime_bands); year-end thin = AMPLIFIER both ways, squaring is not a damper (1223/+5010, 1224/-2450, 1231/-2630). REFINED-vs-ACTUAL (per-event): 1203 +1400/+1520, 1204 +1000/+1100, 1205 +1800/+2440, 1208 -2400/-2730 (gap -1200/-2380+390), 1209 -2500/-2840, 1210 -700/+370 MISS, 1211 -2600/-3970, 1212 -1200/-1180, 1215 -1300/-1560, 1216 -1000/-1020, 1217 +1200/+1880, 1218 -1500/-1830, 1219 +600/+850, 1222 -500/-630, 1223 +2000/+5010, 1224 -1800/-2450, 1226 +500/+670, 1229 0/-10, 1230 +100/+180, 1231 -2000/-2630. Direction 19/20. IRREDUCIBLE: (a) 1210 +370 (third-day pause after two at-extreme-close crashes - the rules say continue; 1008->1009 continued in the identical state); (b) the extreme tails beyond band-high, now TWO-SIDED (1223 +5010 vs +2400 band-top; 1205 +2440/+3560; 1211 -3970) - the standing dominant residual; (c) the Sunday-gap SIZE (1207 -2380: direction callable off the armed crest, magnitude not); (d) the post-termination year-end regime (basing vs new up-chain: the 1222/1223 flip signature ended the down-chain - no new lows - but 1224/1231 still crashed; two-sided basing is not sequencable beyond one day). meta.s100_2_flip_characterization: THE CENTRAL DELIVERABLE - structure.chain_polarity_flip per instance, across every termination and near-termination in the walk. THE RULE IS KEPT AND IS USED ON THE INSTANCES ITS CONDITIONS DISCRIMINATE ON. C1 (band-break) WORKS EVERYWHERE TESTED: fires 1008 (-1800, 2x), 1020 (+2660), 1208 (-2730, 3x), 1223 (+5010, 2.6x), 0120 (+1930, 3.9x the day-2 bounce band); correctly declines 0107 (+1510, inside the +800..+1900 bounce band). Five fires, one correct decline, zero false positives spanning G4, G5, G9, G10 and G11 - C1 is the load-bearing condition and is sufficient on its own on every instance in the walk. C2 (old-side continuation-collapse) WORKS ON LOW-ACTIVITY TAPES and DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE ON HIGH-ACTIVITY TAPES: it fires correctly on 1008 (up 0/15), 1020 (dn 1/10, big 0/2), 1208 (up 3/33, big 2/6) and 1223 (dn 3/38, big 2/6), and it produces the sharpest correct rejection in the walk on 0107 (dn 10/36 with big down-legs 6/7 STILL ALIVE - the old side more alive than the new); but on 0120 it returns a FALSE NEGATIVE, with down legs still continuing ~64%. THE DISCRIMINATING CONDITION IS TAPE ACTIVITY, and the mechanism is that C2 is an absolute share-of-legs threshold applied to a leg count that varies tenfold across regimes: every instance C2 was calibrated on carries 15-98 legs on 15-25k trades per session, while G11's sessions carry 160-550 legs on 75-125k trades. On a high-activity tape both sides always retain a live share and a <=15% absolute threshold is mechanically unreachable. THE FIX IS A REFORMULATION, NOT A REMOVAL: express C2 as the RATIO of old-side to new-side continuation, which is scale-invariant and separates cleanly on fingerprint-comparable data (1020 0.00, 1208 0.40, 1223 0.42 vs the false 0107 at 1.23). G11 cannot yet be placed on that scale - month_characterize has not been run on the G11 tape - and that is a DECLARED BUILD GAP, not a result. C3 (never front-run) is forward-confirmed as a discipline: it correctly blocked the 0108 front-run and correctly withheld a flip at G11's 0119 and 0120 opens, and it does NOT block the flip at the 0121 open because the confirm had printed. C4 (catalyst arbiter) is forward-confirmed twice: 0109's chain-side delivery refuted the false flip, and G11's 0130 print - the surplus NARROWING 263->248, the first weekly print all winter to stop re-confirming the down-chain - supplied exactly the forward fundamental driver whose ABSENCE on 0107 correctly denied a birth. THE TERMINATION-vs-BIRTH SPLIT SURVIVES G11 INTACT and is strengthened: 0107 had no driver and yielded nothing; 0120 had an accelerating cold ramp adding at new horizons and later a confirming storage turn, and it yielded a chain. NOTE ON INFORMATION REQUIREMENTS: C1, C2 and C4 are ALL measurable at the confirm day's CLOSE, so the flip is open-time callable at the FOLLOWING session's open. The G11 miss is therefore as much a PROTOCOL residual as a rule residual - the one-shot blind protocol withholds the 0120 close that carries the confirm. Fourth independent appearance of the live-coach argument.

meta.s100_2_mos_characterization: FIRST-USE CHARACTERIZATION of the MOS weather_forecast block (three sign flips: 0123 helped, 0125 and 0126 hurt). PER-EVENT, AND EXPLICITLY NOT A VERDICT - weather_forecast stays in decision_state in full and permanently; the agent decides how to use it. No gating, down-weighting or quarantine is proposed or implied. WHAT THE RUN-DELTA DISCRIMINATES ON: FIRST-APPEARANCE adds - a shot entering at horizons that previously carried nothing. 0123 is the clean instance: +2.885 at Jan 27 and +4.500 at Jan 28, horizons empty the run before; the blind run took the up side against what its own chain read would have called, and HIT (+800 guessed, +1170 actual). 0119 is the same form one step earlier: +8.511 at Jan 24, the block's information event. WHAT IT DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE ON: REVISIONS to a shot already in the models and already priced. 0125 is the sharpest case - the -2.315 cut at Jan 30 drove an explicit negative-gap call and the actual gap was +2480, the block's largest; the shot being wobbled had been priced since 0119. 0126 is its mirror - the +3.197 re-add at the SAME horizon one run later flipped a carry-DOWN call that would have been right (actual -620). The two revisions cancel to approximately nothing within two runs, which is both the evidence and the mechanism: a market prices a shot once, and subsequent few-gw-HDD wobble at a horizon it already occupies is inside the noise the option/vol market has already absorbed. New play signal.mos_first_appearance_vs_revision, n=2 first-appearance and n=2 revision, all within G11 - ZERO forward evidence, must survive G12+ before it is treated as blind-applicable. A SEPARATE AND INDEPENDENT LIMITATION, not a property of the signal: the stream is D-1-EVENING and is therefore one model cycle BEHIND the weekend repricing (see s100_2_weekend_gap_note).
meta.s100_2_evidence_fields_note: S100.2 adds THREE FIELDS TO EVERY PLAY - `requires`, `scope`, `forward_evidence`. RATIONALE, load-bearing: most blind-versus-refined disagreements are not disagreements about the market at all, they are differences in what was KNOWABLE at decision time, and treating them as a precedence problem hides that. `requires` (open_time_only / needs_day_N-1_tape / needs_intraday_reveal) names the information a play consumes and dissolves those apparent conflicts. `scope` (leg side / day net / block lean / magnitude / gap / timing) names what a play OWNS, which is the correct precedence axis and the one S97.2 already settled when it gave R2 the post-print leg side and magnitude while the chain kept the day net. `forward_evidence` records whether a play has been confirmed on a block it was NOT derived from, and it is the field that GATES PROMOTION: refined rules are hindsight-fitted and carry zero forward evidence, so they must NEVER silently overwrite blind-applicable ones. Doing so would promote in-sample fits into the operating playbook untested, and it would destroy the blind-versus-refined GAP, which is itself the measurement of how much of the edge is sequential rather than open-time (G7 was 3/10 blind against 9/10 refined; R2 was 4/10 blind against 10/10 refined; G11 is 6/12 blind against 10/12 refined). A refined rule earns open-time status only by surviving a forward block. WHERE TWO PLAYS OVERLAP IN SCOPE WITHOUT A SETTLED BOUNDARY, THE OVERLAP IS FLAGGED RATHER THAN RESOLVED - see s100_2_scope_overlaps_flagged.
meta.s100_2_scope_overlaps_flagged: FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED - scope overlaps with no settled boundary, listed so they are not silently arbitrated. (1) structure.mature_swing_alternation and direction.giveback_exhaustion_boundary both claim the DAY NET of the session after an extreme, both require day-N-1 tape, and on G11's 0122 they agree only by accident (R4 called the give-back, R1's close read on 0121 said continue). No boundary is proposed. (2) structure.failed_rally_tell and direction.giveback_exhaustion_boundary both read a round-tripped session's close and reach OPPOSITE conclusions - the tell says the round-trip exhausts the counter side and the next session runs chain-side, R1 says a deep recovery means the give-back exhausted and the swing resumes. The unmodelled separator appears to be which POLARITY the round-tripping day belongs to, but the tell has never been tested at up-polarity, so this is a research finding, not a rule. (3) daytype.weekday_archetype and structure.post_parabolic_bleed both offer a day-net class band; the brain already says the archetype is overridden by the chain, which is a precedence statement rather than a scope split, and it is left as is.
meta.s100_2_same_information_conflicts: GENUINE CONFLICTS - plays that are BOTH open_time_only and make OPPOSITE calls on the SAME information. These are NOT resolved by precedence; one is wrong or an unmodelled condition separates them, and they are recorded as research findings. (1) THE G11 BLOCK-OPEN CONFLICT: structure.post_parabolic_bleed (open_time_only) said the carried down-polarity holds until a confirm prints, and timing.catalyst_continuity_frontrun (open_time_only) said a live accelerating ramp fires the next session. On 0119-0121 they pointed opposite ways on identical open-time information. The blind run took the bleed and lost the block. The candidate separator is whether the ramp is adding at FIRST-APPEARANCE horizons or merely being revised - which is the new mos play - but that is derived on this same block and therefore cannot also adjudicate it. UNRESOLVED. (2) THE 0125 GAP-SIGN CONFLICT: daytype.monday_weekend_gap's priced-shock arm and the raw realized-cold read in decision_state.weather pointed opposite ways on the same Sunday, and the blind run explicitly recorded that it was rejecting the realized-cold read, which was the side that paid. Neither play owns the gap sign cleanly. UNRESOLVED, and it is the specific reason magnitude.weekend_gap_delivery is written to give the gap SIGN to the running chain rather than to either weather read.
meta.s100_2_irreducibles: DECLARED IRREDUCIBLE for G11, each with its mechanism. (a) THE WEEKEND-GAP MAGNITUDE on a fresh-shot weekend (0118 +2100, 0125 +2480): the repricing is priced off the Sat/Sun 00Z/12Z model cycle and decision_state carries only the D-1-evening run - the market is one model cycle ahead of the state variable. A DATA BUILD closes it, no reasoning does. (b) THE CRESTING-RAMP PAUSE PAIR (0127 -260, 0128 -400): under a cresting ramp R1's two arms disagree - the depth arm reads exhaustion and resume, the last-hour arm reads continuation - and the day nets sit inside +-500 where the boundary read carries no edge. Two consecutive sign misses inside that band is the honest result; no rule is added to capture them, because any rule that did would be fitted to two days. (c) THE EXTREME-DAY MAGNITUDE (0121 +3820 against a band top of 3000; 0130 +5020 against 2200) - the standing dominant residual of the entire walk, now two-sided and confirmed on every block since G6. (d) 0130 SPECIFICALLY carries an unmodelled driver: the expiring February contract ran 3.0 -> 5.4 into delivery and a delivery squeeze was pulling the strip, while the forecaster carries NO state variable exposing front-month expiry, open-interest concentration or the Feb/Mar calendar spread. That is a MISSING STATE VARIABLE with a named fix, not an unforecastable event - and it is the highest-value addition to decision_state this pass identified. (e) THE FLIP-CONFIRM PHASE in one-shot mode: C1 was measurable only at the 0120 close, which the one-shot protocol withholds - the standing protocol residual, fourth appearance.

reasoning_method.note: HOW he reasons - the general method applied every day. Per-event, never averaged; drift is a DESCRIPTOR tied to conditions, never point-fit.
reasoning_method.continuous_frame: Reason CONTINUOUSLY, one day into the next. Each day's forecast FLOWS from the prior day's close + trajectory + running state - a continuation-or-turn of the running path, never a from-flat isolated event. CAUTION (s95_2): the continuous data series contains CONTRACT ROLLS (~monthly) that inject a fake overnight jump (G3-5: the Sep24->25 +0.276 Oct->Nov roll). At a known roll boundary forecast the REAL overnight ~0 and reason on roll-clean intraday nets; never read a roll jump as a market move / swing turn.
reasoning_method.anchor: Start each block from the ACTUAL hr24 of the day BEFORE the block (blind-safe). Within the block, each day flows from the agent's OWN prior-day guessed close.
reasoning_method.block_open_lean: At a block boundary, LEAN AGAINST a stretched swing - but the trigger is SWING EXHAUSTION, not the calendar seam: weight a reversal when the running (roll-clean) path is at a cum-EXTREME AND the old block's LAST 1-2 days show a counter-move (0923 bounce + 0924 hold before the G3->G4 up-turn; 1007 last-hour roll-over before the G4->G5 crash). The reversal is delivered through the INTRADAY US SESSIONS (G3->G4 first week) or as an intraday US-session CRASH (1008), and occasionally pre-loaded by a real overnight/weekend GAP (1019 +1570). Do NOT extend the trend into a stretched seam; do NOT blind-fade a still-trending block with no last-day counter-move. G6 CAVEAT: this reversion is a GIVE-BACK, not a sustained reversal - the block can itself V back (G5, G6), so do not marry the new lean past its own exhaustion. Confirm with intraday flow.
reasoning_method.fundamentals_role: Storage surplus/deficit + HDD/CDD regime = a SLOW, WEAK block-trajectory backdrop, NEVER a day-level or pre-print side/timing signal. The +150 Bcf surplus called G3 down. BUT (G6, load-bearing): near the seasonal (autumn->winter) transition the surplus is an UNRELIABLE block-direction cue - rising HDD (heating demand) flipped the block UP through G4/Oct and won in G6 despite the bearish surplus. Treat fundamentals as a lean of last resort, dominated by the running trajectory and the swing-exhaustion read.
reasoning_method.daytype_priors: Monday = BIG mover, but the weekend repricing arrives at the SUNDAY reopen gap and Monday's US session is the REACTION (R3: fade a mature-swing gap, extend a fresh-turn gap, else carry Friday's side) - the old 'often a REVERSAL' lean is retired (G7: both Mondays continued). Thin-holiday size-down only with NO active weather catalyst (1013 yes, 1111 no). Storage Thursday = large dominant leg at/after the 10:30 ET print, size UP; SIDE = the running swing/turn state, never the print sign (R2, 10/10 G3-G7). Fri = range (overridden in a high-momentum reversal regime AND by R4 give-back-after-extreme: 1107, 1114). Tue = strongest-trend weekday. Wed = weak up-lean (overridden by block trend). Never pool across DOW.
reasoning_method.intraday_side: OPEN-time from-flat side is a coin-flip (stays OPEN). WITHIN the day the side is CALLED by (1) dip_imb_level flow nowcast (held legs' flow sign matches leg dir near-perfect) and (2) CONTINUATION-ASYMMETRY (true-direction legs continue, counter-dir die). A counter-trend GRIND is real (block trend does not veto it) - BUT it is NOT callable AT THE OPEN (0916, G6 week-2): no open-time signal distinguishes a counter-trend grind from a continuation day. CAVEAT: flow_nowcast LAGS an extreme gap melt-up (1020 7/12) - lean on continuation-asymmetry there. Shape (grind holds / peaked_fast spike fades, 23/24) decides hold-vs-close.
reasoning_method.magnitude_sizing: Size per event vs the running trajectory + regime; do NOT globally rescale. The under-forecast is CONCENTRATED on three catalyst conditions - weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, swing-reversal/seam - which run to MULTIPLES of default; non-catalyst chop is sized ~right. Stack the up-sizers when they coincide (1020: Monday + reversal + swing-turn). G6 CONFIRMS magnitude is the DOMINANT residual error (undersized both the dip and the recovery) - even after condition-sorting, expect to under-size the extremes; do NOT clip the ride. Use the $350 staircase as the real-time continuation read.
reasoning_method.shape_and_exit: A slow GRIND holds; a front-loaded peaked_fast SPIKE round-trips (fingerprint-confirmed 23/24). REVISED: turn_far_thinning did NOT confirm as the live recruitment/exit discriminator - treat it as a diagnostic only. Use continuation/retention + peaked_fast + flow for the running turn.
reasoning_method.discipline: PER-EVENT only, never average/pool/count. Drift is a DESCRIPTOR - tie each miss to its CONDITIONS, never point-fit. GENERAL rules (mechanism + n) only.
reasoning_method.swing_exhaustion_reversion: GENERAL mechanism, fingerprint-CONFIRMED via a CONTINUATION-COLLAPSE signature: at a swing turn the OLD-direction legs STOP continuing and turn_exhaustion goes negative, while the NEW direction begins to hold at the extreme. Named: G4->G5 top 1008 (old-swing UP 0/15 - total exhaustion, dominant DOWN 12/26); G5 V-bottom 1016 (UP recruits hold 5/18 on a down-close day); intra-block 0916 (block-DOWN legs 1/11) and G3 0922 low -> 0923 bounce. The turn begins in the old swing's last legs and completes through the INTRADAY sessions (G3->G4) or as an intraday US-session CRASH (1008), sometimes pre-loaded by a real overnight/weekend GAP (1019 +1570). CORRECTION (s95_2): the previously-cited '0925 +2760 overnight gap' delivery form is VOID - that was the Oct->Nov contract roll, NOT a swing turn. Do NOT extend trend into a stretched swing; watch for the old-direction continuation-collapse. G6: the reversion is a GIVE-BACK - a block can V back, so treat each leg of the swing as its own exhaustible move.
reasoning_method.magnitude_catalyst_sort: GENERAL: sort the big days by CONDITION, do not rescale. UP-size on weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, and swing-reversal/seam days. DOWN-size on thin-holiday Monday (1013), Sunday carry, non-catalyst chop. Compound the up-sizers when they coincide (1020). G6: still expect to under-size the extremes - magnitude is the dominant residual.
reasoning_method.giveback_exhaustion_boundary: R1 (S96.2, the sequencing solvent): read the give-back's OWN close. EXHAUSTED = closes >=~40-50% off its intraday extreme + last-hours counter-tick + no continuation-collapse in the underlying swing's big legs -> next session RESUMES the swing (size up if a catalyst day). NOT exhausted = closes at/near its extreme with last hours extending -> give-back CONTINUES. If the swing side's own legs have already collapsed (0915 down 0/8), stand down - the swing is suspect, no resume call. n: resume 1105->1106, 1107->1109gap, 1110->1111, 1112->1113 (G7), 0926->0929, 1003->1005 (G4); continue 1002->1003 (G4), 1114->1117 (G7); filter 0915->0916 (G3). Mechanism: a give-back is positioning unwind inside an intact flow regime - when the unwind cannot hold its lows into the close, the sellers are done and the dominant flow re-asserts; the last hour is the earliest tell (hr24->hr1).
reasoning_method.mature_swing_alternation: R4 (S96.2): swing AGE gates day-sequencing. YOUNG swing (<=3 sessions since the turn) chains extensions day-after-day (0929/0930/1001 G4; 1030/1031/1103/1104 G6). MATURE swing (>=4 sessions): a material fresh extreme close (>= ~$300 beyond the prior extreme) is NEVER followed by a consecutive extension - the next session is a give-back/hold (G7 5/5: 1104->1105, 1106->1107, 1109->1110, 1111->1112, 1113->1114; 1007->1008 G4). Then R1 decides whether the give-back exhausts (resume) or runs (continue). Mechanism: early in a swing the repricing is under-done (info still propagating); late, each new extreme exhausts the marginal buyer - swing-exhaustion in incremental form.
reasoning_method.weekend_gap_reaction: R3 (S96.2): the weekend repricing is delivered AT THE SUNDAY REOPEN as the gap - Monday's US session is the REACTION, not the repricing. Gap WITH a mature swing to a fresh cum-extreme -> Monday FADES it (1109 +1560 -> 1110 -820; 0908 +460 -> faded +740->+190). Gap at a FRESH turn (<=~2 sessions old) -> Monday EXTENDS (1019 +1570 -> 1020 +2660). No material gap -> Monday carries FRIDAY's side (1107->1110, 1114->1117 G7; 0919->0922 G3; 1017->1020 G5). Monday bigness stands; Monday-as-block-reversal is retired (the G3-5 'reversals' were swing-state coincidences).
reasoning_method.giveback_origin_shelf_floor: R5 (S96.2): a terminal give-back runs until it retraces to the swing's ORIGIN/consolidation shelf, then stabilizes (give-back-not-reversal). At >=~75% retrace of the swing, the R1 closes-at-low continuation read INVERTS: capitulation closes at stretched extremes precede the BOUNCE (0922->0923 +610 G3; 1016->1017 +740 G5; 1117->1118 +270 G7; also 1029 stall -> 1030 +2580 G6 as the Thursday-turn form). Mechanism: the give-back unwinds the crowd that entered during the extension; once price returns to where the extension began there is no trapped inventory left to force further. Use for give-back sizing (floor) and for calling the stabilization/turn day. S98.2 CAVEAT: the shelf floor holds only for NON-parabolic give-backs (G7). After a confirmed polarity flip off a parabolic run the shelf is VOID and breaks (1211 through 4.367) - the break itself is the flip's confirmation.
reasoning_method.chain_polarity: S98.2 + S99.2 HARDENED (the G9+G10 lessons, load-bearing): every sequencing rule is POLARITY-RELATIVE - 'resume' means resume the RUNNING chain's direction, and BANDS are polarity-relative too (ramp-shallow give-backs belong to up-chains; a live cold ramp in a down-chain is the COUNTER catalyst - it feeds 1-2 day bounces and full crash-band days when they die: 0114). The polarity flips ONLY at a confirmed structure.chain_polarity_flip passing the HARDENED four-condition bar (band-break >=1.5x + old-side continuation-collapse in the actual tape + printed-not-front-run + the catalyst-arbiter/backdrop check) - a strong in-band bounce is NEVER a flip (0107, 1217, 1223-as-birth). TERMINATION does not equal BIRTH: without a forward fundamental driver a terminated chain enters the POST-PARABOLIC BLEED at the old polarity (see structure.post_parabolic_bleed) - the down-chain 'ends' only on the tape, never in the lean, until a true confirm prints. In a flipped/down regime: cold-delivery days FAIL, bullish prints SELL (8/8), and R1's symmetric close-vs-extreme read runs the alternation - reading CHAIN-SIDE days' closes only (a counter/fade day's recovered close carries no bounce signal: 0105).
reasoning_method.post_parabolic_bleed: S99.2 (the G10 class): after a parabolic chain's termination signature fires WITHOUT a birth driver, the regime is neither trend-chain nor two-sided basing but a stepped BLEED at the old polarity: single crash days, 1-2 day bounces (never 3), post-crash pauses, more small days, marginal new lows. Sequencing: bounce-death + failed_rally_tell -> crash; crash -> pause (crashes chain only INTO a print day); print days chain-sided and, on in-chain confirmations, sized DOWN a class. The bleed persists as long as the fundamental stream keeps re-confirming the old chain (G10: the whole block).

plays.read: run length + amplitude vs the season's prior largest swing + the extension day's close-vs-extreme; then the counter day's net vs its condition-class band + old-direction continuation-collapse; a weekend gap AGAINST the crest counts as the counter
plays.call: ARM when the swing is PARABOLIC (>=~1.5-2x the season's prior largest swing amplitude, >=~9 sessions, no origin-shelf touch) AND the extension day closes >=~30% off its intraday extreme (blow-off / late-tape roll-over). CONFIRM (S99.2 HARDENED - ALL conditions): (C1) BAND-BREAK: the first counter day's net breaks its condition-class counter band by >=~1.5x (an in-band bounce, however strong-looking, is NOT a confirm); (C2) OLD-SIDE CONTINUATION-COLLAPSE verified in that day's ACTUAL tape: old-direction legs continuing <=~15% overall AND old-side big legs (>=$300) not majority-alive (<=~1/3 or absent); (C3) PRINTED, NEVER FRONT-RUN: polarity flips only AFTER the confirm day closes - catalyst_continuity_frontrun applies to WITH-chain resumes only, never to a flip; (C4) in the waited/no-band-break form the next scheduled print is the ARBITER: counter-side delivery confirms the turn (0925, 1030), chain-side delivery refutes it (0109). TERMINATION vs BIRTH: a passing signature always ENDS the old chain (no fundamental agreement needed - 1208 flipped against a bullish backdrop), but a sustained counter-CHAIN births only with a forward fundamental driver; if the weekly fundamental stream is actively RE-CONFIRMING the old chain (surplus re-widening under a down-chain), the outcome is TERMINATION-TO-BASING/BLEED (structure.post_parabolic_bleed), not a new chain. After a true CONFIRM: every polarity-relative rule reads in the NEW direction and R5's origin shelf is VOID. Without the parabolic arm, an armed crest is only a GIVE-BACK (G7) - do not flip. || S100.2 PER-INSTANCE REFINEMENT: C1 (band-break) is the load-bearing condition and is sufficient on its own across every instance tested. || S100.3 C2 MEASURED (comparable base, see meta.s100_3_c2_measured_note + C2_RATIO_FINDINGS_S98.md): the ratio reformulation is REFUTED - 0120 (true) 0.714 vs 0107 (false) 0.718, near-identical on every C2 arm. s101_3_sizing_rule.rule_statement: CONDITION: the prompt month's expiry has passed within <=~3 sessions AND its premium is STRANDED in the surviving front (a parabolic squeeze leg ran into that expiry; front-next spread multiples of its norm; cash-basis blow-off) - the anchor_structural gap-owner condition of item 2. BEHAVIOR, all quantities measurable at the decision-time close: (1) define the PREMIUM P = anchor close minus the PRE-SQUEEZE SHELF (the close of the last session before the squeeze-pull leg began - the squeeze leg's giveback_origin_shelf; G12: 4.416 - 3.159 = $12,570); (2) define the ECHO RUN E = cum net of the sessions strictly AFTER the prompt expiry (calendar-defined, zero discretion; G12: 0129 +1480 + 0130 +5020 = +$6,500); (3) DEAD-SPONSOR WEEKEND GAP = -E, band -0.75E..-1.25E (G12: -4,875..-8,125; refined -6,500; actual -7,080 = 1.09E, IN BAND); (4) NEXT SESSION = unwind-to-shelf: net = -(prior actual close - shelf) less a basing stub of a few hundred, band ~+-20% (G12: remaining -4,980; refined -4,500 band -4,000..-5,000; actual -4,260 to 3.231, the shelf 3.159 held to a 0.072 stub); (5) the SHELF HOLDS in the squeeze form (the premium, not the fundamental level, was the error) - versus the weather-parabola form where the origin BREAKS (G9 1211 through 4.367); this is the named discriminator between the two post-parabolic classes.
s101_3_sizing_rule.mechanism: Post-expiry appreciation in the front has no delivery anchor and no sponsor - it is covering echo. No holder carries unowned squeeze premium across the longest liquidity gap on the calendar, so the echo run evaporates entirely at the weekend reopen (gap = -E), and the remainder of the stranded premium unwinds to the level where the squeeze-pull began (the shelf) in the following session(s), where it stops - because below the shelf price is no longer squeeze-priced.
s101_3_sizing_rule.n_and_honesty: n=1 dead-sponsor instance (0201-0202) for the magnitude derivation - declared. What makes it a rule and not a fit: (a) every input (expiry date, E, P, shelf) is a mechanical anchor-state quantity, no free constant (the retrace fraction is 1.0 = 'entirely', not tuned); (b) the CONDITION is n=3-backed at the ownership level (structural gaps 1207/0125/0201 spanning G9/G11/G12); (c) prompt expiries occur EVERY month of the walk and the rule fires exactly once - no other month had stranded premium (no squeeze leg, normal spreads, no cash blow-off) - its eleven non-firings ARE the back-check; (d) the armed-crest structural gap (1207) is a DIFFERENT class (flip counter delivery, existing crash/counter band) and is NOT sized by this rule - stated below.

plays.trigger: a weekend / holiday reopen SEAM in a crowded-short regime (MM net at a low 1y-pctile)
plays.read: the COT WoW delta at the last publication + the inherited extension state
plays.call: The reopen GAP is NOT non-derivable noise - it carries a DIRECTIONAL prior. WORSENING WoW = the seam is the covering rally's FIRING window -> attach an UP gap prior at the block's covering-seam quantum, RECURRING on every seam while the COT keeps worsening; an UNFIRED maximal crowded short at a seam is BASE-CASE UP (a loaded spring), not a down-continuation with a small squeeze tail. FLAT WoW -> no prior, gap sign reverts to noise. The D-1 close-exit delivery-vs-absorption read is ORTHOGONAL to the seam sign (it governs intraday continuation, not the gap). MAGNITUDE is GAP-FIRST and allocated in two separately-derived parts: the seam gap (extension-INDEPENDENT, same quantum each seam) + the intraday (extension-GATED: at low extension the aligned continuation EXCEEDS the gap; at high extension it round-trips to ~0 and the day IS the gap). The Monday 06-10 catch-up window TESTS the gap rather than generating direction - a negative-conviction window leaves the gap intact (and may print the day's extreme); only positive-conviction aggression back through the gap overturns it.

plays.trigger: before applying ANY big_print_b_share threshold (the 0.55 conviction arm, accumulation_arm_turn, eia_preprint_overextension_gate flow-coherence)
plays.read: big_prints_n for the session the ratio is computed on - the SAMPLE SIZE behind the ratio
plays.call: Below ~20 big prints in the session, the 0.55 bar OVER-FIRES on noise: raise the bar to ~0.60 for that session, or stand the arm down and say so. At or above ~20 big prints, 0.55 stands as measured. Do NOT float the bar by season - see the negative result below.
plays.mechanism: big_print_b_share is a proportion. Its dispersion is governed by the number of big prints behind it, so on a thin tape it wanders away from 0.50 for purely statistical reasons and an absolute bar silently becomes a looser bar. Measured: the thinnest quartile carries roughly DOUBLE the dispersion of the other three - sd 0.255 (median 9 big prints) versus 0.132 / 0.120 / 0.127. corr(|b_share - 0.50|, log big_prints_n) = -0.465, so extremity is substantially a thin-sample artifact.

evidence.n: 204 sessions with a usable big-print read, 2025-11-02 through 2026-07-20 (spans winter, shoulder and summer), computed on the CORRECTED size-weighted series
evidence.pooled: mean 0.461, sd 0.169, p50 0.479; 0.55 sits at the 72.5th percentile and fires on 27.5% of sessions
evidence.shape: The equal-rate bar is a STEP, not a smooth decay - elevated only in the thinnest quartile and flat (0.536-0.547) across the other three. That is why the guard is a single thin-tape condition and not a continuous function.
evidence.guard_effect_measured: Per-quartile fire-rate spread under a FIXED 0.55 is 7.9pp [31.4, 26.9, 23.5, 28.0]. Under the guard (0.60 when big_prints_n <= ~20, else 0.55) it is 4.5pp [23.5, 26.9, 23.5, 28.0]. The fixed bar is already reasonably well behaved; the thin quartile is the only material offender and the guard is a modest, targeted correction - it is NOT a large effect and should not be sold as one.

negative_result_reported.tested_and_REJECTED: the smooth noise model bar = 0.50 + k/sqrt(big_prints_n)
negative_result_reported.result: WORSE than the fixed bar at every k tested. Per-quartile fire-rate spread: k=0.25 -> 18.5pp, k=0.33 -> 22.4pp, k=0.40 -> 22.3pp, k=0.50 -> 16.3pp, versus FIXED 0.55 -> 7.9pp. The 1/sqrt(n) form over-corrects the thick tail, where the empirical equal-rate bar has already flattened, so it ends up FIRING MORE on the thickest quartile than the thinnest - the opposite of the intent.
negative_result_reported.why_this_is_reported: Result Discipline: the elegant form was tested first and lost badly to the crude one. Recording the loss is what stops it being re-proposed next session.

plays.trigger: any session. The vessel line is the ONLY LIVE LNG channel in the state - read it whenever the export term could matter, and ALWAYS on a week where departures or capacity step.
plays.read: ngwu_balance.lng_vessels_departed and lng_vessel_capacity_bcf (Vortexa tanker tracker, published by EIA in the WNGSR Supplement). Weekly cadence. Read the STEP, not the level: departures x capacity is realized export throughput, so a liquefaction outage or a restart shows up here within a week even though feedgas nominations are not available.
plays.call: TREAT AS CONTEXT, NOT AS A SIGNAL. There is no forward evidence that this channel sorts direction or sizes magnitude - it has never been tested. Use it to avoid being blind to a large export move, and to flag when the export term is changing under a forecast that assumes it static. Do NOT fire a direction or a band off it. If it steps hard against your thesis, say so and widen, rather than resolving it in your own favour.
plays.mechanism: LNG feedgas is structurally one of the biggest modern NG drivers (a Freeport-class outage reprices the curve for months - S97 item 8). The live feedgas line DIED with the S&P section of the free weekly balance on 2025-10-02: ngwu_balance.lng_feedgas_bcfd is null, and the only feedgas figure carried (16.3) sits in latest_sd_levels at week_ending 2025-09-24, 278 days stale and self-declared sd_live:false. The VESSEL line survived that death and still advances. Departures x capacity is a coarse, lagging, but REAL measure of the same physical export throughput. S109 addendum (Greg): the two things that will move this line next are Gulf hurricanes hitting the Gulf Coast liquefaction fleet, and a Middle East supply hole pulling additional US cargoes. Both are exactly the case where feedgas would be the right instrument and is unavailable - which is why the throughput proxy is worth having.
plays.evidence: S109 audit: across G22 the line moves - lng_vessels_departed 36,36,36,36,35,35,35,35,35,36 and lng_vessel_capacity_bcf 133.0 -> 135.0 -> 136.0, attribution 'Vortexa Analytics tanker tracker (published by EIA, WNGSR Supplement)'. Confirmed live and updating on a weekly cadence.
plays.status: WIRED_UNPROVEN - merged on Greg's instruction (S109) to make a live channel readable. Zero brain plays referenced LNG, vessel or feedgas before this.
plays.confidence: none-yet (monitoring). No forward evidence exists. Explicitly NOT promoted on the basis of plausibility.
plays.caveats: WEEKLY resolution, so it cannot time a day. It LAGS the physical event - a cargo departs after liquefaction has already run. Capacity is fleet-mix dependent, so a capacity step is not necessarily a throughput step. And it is a THROUGHPUT proxy, not a feedgas nomination: it will miss an outage that has begun but not yet shown up in departures. AND THE HURRICANE CASE IS THE ONE IT IS WEAKEST ON: departures LAG, so a terminal that shuts today shows up in this line days later, while the price reacts to the storm track immediately. Treat it as CONFIRMATION of an export disruption, never as the early warning. We carry NO tropical/hurricane feed at all - freeze_risk is the winter analogue and has no summer counterpart. Named gap.
plays.scope: All seasons, and TWO live forward drivers make it more informative from here, not less (Greg, S109). (1) GULF HURRICANE SEASON: the US liquefaction fleet is Gulf Coast - Sabine Pass, Corpus Christi, Freeport, Cameron - so a storm track through the Gulf hits export capacity and Gulf production at the same time, and the two pull gas price in OPPOSITE directions. Departures are the observable that separates them: a terminal outage shows up as departures collapsing while production returns. Season is Aug-Oct and it is live NOW. (2) A MIDDLE EAST SUPPLY HOLE pulling cargoes: if that supply is short, more US cargoes leave, export throughput rises and the pull is bullish US gas. Both are STEP events, which is what this line reads. It remains a SLOWER term than the weather/renewables stack.
plays.forward_evidence: NONE. First ride is the next group. The falsifier: if departure/capacity STEPS show no association with realized moves across the walked blocks once the line is backfilled, this stays a context field and is never promoted to a signal. Do not fit a threshold to it.

usage_doctrine.note: Per-source-family READING guidance (gate item 1). How to read each family - the agent decides application.
usage_doctrine.weather_mos: FIRST-APPEARANCE adds at previously-empty horizons are the driver class; REVISIONS to already-priced horizons are the noise class (s100_2_mos_characterization, n thin - forward evidence rides G12+). D+4-8 = the battleground horizons where repricing concentrates. The weekend 00z/12z cycles price the SUNDAY REOPEN - weather_forecast_cycle (feed A ph1) carries them decision-time; the D-1-evening block alone is one cycle behind every reopen. freeze_risk (feed E) is the SUPPLY side of cold: sub-20F producing-basin runs cut supply while demand spikes - the convexity mechanism behind band overshoots.
usage_doctrine.storage: The weekly print RE-ANCHORS the fundamental backdrop; it never owns the day side (prints trade chain-sided at current polarity, 9/9 through G11). SALT is the fast-cycling front-month scarcity read; composition (regional vs headline) is the second wave. Survey consensus and seasonal proxy are BOTH carried - surprise is vs consensus where consensus exists.
usage_doctrine.cot: Positioning is a CONVEXITY CONDITIONER, never timing or direction. Percentile extremes flag band-overshoot regimes (squeezes overshoot every band). NEVER fade the crowded side during its squeeze. Limits: weekly cadence, Tuesday-positions-Friday-publication, and the futures book and options-implied book can sit at OPPOSITE extremes (G11 open: 2.83rd vs 97.17th pctile) - read BOTH.
usage_doctrine.structure: Curve LEVEL is state; the widening RATE is signal. The expiry clock switches the regime (squeeze_watch active = delivery physics) - and only the CALENDAR-FRONT fields see it (the OI-front hides the squeeze; 0122: 0.093 vs 1.539). squeeze_watch is a read, not a gate.
usage_doctrine.vol: vol_regime scales BANDS only, never calls direction. n0/v0 bases never mixed.
usage_doctrine.options: OI walls = the pin map near opex (pin/unpin boundary = opex day, the business day before expiry). Wall concentrations near settle act as magnets/friction zones. IV (phase ii, pending) = uncertainty scaler, never direction.
usage_doctrine.power_solar_nuclear_grid: Slow demand-share backdrop + the daily burn nowcast (grid_stack); nuclear GW offline adds burn ~GW-for-GW; the sunset ramp (solar_calendar) is an intraday clock feature, not a daily driver.
usage_doctrine.cash: Cash basis is delivery-stress GROUND TRUTH the paper market converges to - but it publishes in WEEKLY BATCHES; never assume daily availability (the 0130 +10.77 lands decision-time-legit ON the 17x day, not before).

seasonal_salience_slider.provenance: Greg, desk doctrine, paraphrased faithfully: 'the scoring weights slide through the year - weather is a lot more important in winter and summer than fall and spring.'
seasonal_salience_slider.text: (a) Input-family importance is SEASONAL, not fixed: WEATHER (MOS stream, cycles, freeze risk, HDD/CDD) carries maximum weight in DEEP WINTER and SUMMER (heating/cooling demand regimes) and fades through FALL and SPRING shoulders; in shoulders the weight shifts toward FLOWS and MAINTENANCE SEASON (nuclear refuel clusters, pipeline work, LNG turnarounds - the nuclear_outages/grid_stack family), storage-TRAJECTORY (the injection/withdrawal season turn), and structure/positioning. (b) HONESTY: the walk's evidence to date is winter-only - the brain's weather-heavy rule set is winter-calibrated BY CIRCUMSTANCE and should be EXPECTED to age as the walk exits winter (G14+ into March/April = the spring shoulder + maintenance season + the injection-season turn). A rule fading in the shoulder is the slider working, not the rule failing - but that judgment requires this slider to be stated. (c) TIE-INS: the G6 lesson (HDD beats surplus at the autumn->winter transition) is the slider's first recorded instance; regime_scope already names warm-season vs winter thinness; the day-class layer is ORTHOGONAL (class first, then seasonal salience inside the class); magnitude bands stay regime/condition-scoped exactly as they are. (d) FORWARD CONSEQUENCE: G14 opens the walk's first shoulder-season blocks - the slider's first forward test; at each block open the agent reads the seasonal position explicitly (calendar + storage phase + HDD/CDD levels) and records which family it weights and why, per-event.

supersession.note: GREG, 2026-07-20 (S100, verbatim intent): 'if i have a decision to make and 1 way was my old way of doing things before i learned how to do it a better way, i don't have to weight the 2 out equally, the old way was forgotten about long ago except for maybe a thought about how not to do it or if it makes me remember to watch something i normally wouldn't. otherwise doesn't factor into decision tree.'
supersession.rule: EXACTLY ONE rule owns a decision node at any time - never two weighed against each other. While a refined rule is in its one-block forward probation, the INCUMBENT rule owns the blind node outright (probation is not co-ownership). The moment the refined rule earns forward evidence, ownership HANDS OFF completely: the superseded rule retires from the decision tree and survives ONLY as (a) a cautionary instance - how not to do it, with its named failure days - and (b) a watch-trigger where it reminds the agent to look at something the new rule does not surface. It is never again a weighted alternative.

gap_ownership_scoring.rule: Gap and net remain separately scored events; what changes is that OWNERSHIP is explicit and the reporting cannot hide one behind the other. (1) DECLARE: every forecast of a block-opening or Sunday reopen gap must carry gap_owner in {anchor_structural, weekend_cycle_weather, chain_drift} declared AT THE ANCHOR/prior close, plus the band class used. (2) SCORE: the scorecard's day row carries gap_dir_ok AND gap_class_ok (realized gap inside the declared band, tail declared = miss with named tail) at EQUAL RANK with net_dir_ok; reopen days additionally carry day_move_dir_ok (sign of gap+net) - the headline hit/miss for a reopen day is the day_move composite, so 0201 reads MISS (+150g vs -7590a day move) with the net sub-score a hit, never the reverse. (3) ATTRIBUTE: when the realized gap's driver class differs from the declared owner, the OWNERSHIP call is scored as the miss (a new ownership_ok flag) - that is the exact error 0201 exposes (blind declared weather-priced; the driver was structural). (4) DRIFT attribution names gap residual separately from net residual per day, as g12_score already does numerically - the change is the headline convention.

refinement_architecture_s103.load_bearing_principle: The OLD (blind) prediction framework STAYS the CORE forecasting model. L1+trades+MBO is NOT a replacement predictor - it is a CAUSAL REFINEMENT LAYER that decides whether the immutable blind is still valid as the session unfolds. The refined output is a POSTERIOR UPDATE OF THE IMMUTABLE BLIND, never a new forecast from scratch. Do not replace a working predictor with a reactive order-flow model.
pieces_in_order: 1 IMMUTABLE BLIND = the starting map (direction, magnitude, timing, turns, daily path; pre-cutoff info only). Never rewritten.

2 FRIDAY ANCHOR = the starting market state (final traded hour before the block: price, dir, volume, signed flow, activity, efficiency, contract identity, queue). First Sunday update is read RELATIVE to this.
3 NORMALIZED L1+TRADES+DEFINITIONS+MBO = ONE chronological stream feeding ONE feature engine. None predict independently.
4 NGLiveOperator + FEATURE STATES = events -> behavior, emitted ONLY at valid completed-event boundaries. Never chase ticks or react to incomplete books.
5 SESSION SPECIALISTS = interpret the SAME feature state by session structure (a feature means different things Sunday vs Tue-core vs EIA-Thu vs expiry/roll-Fri).
6 COORDINATOR = SELECTS the specialist matching the day+state; NEVER averages opposing forecasts; records which, why, dissent, why the alternative was rejected.

7 POSTERIOR REFINEMENT = starts from the blind and adjusts ONLY when causal evidence is MATERIAL (confirm / reduce confidence / delay / resize / identify a turn / flip continuation-vs-reversal / stand down). Emits SEPARATE outputs, not one vague call.

8 DATA QUALITY / STAND-DOWN = controls authority. MBO book-based conclusions require a trustworthy reconstructed book. Book unreliable but trades valid -> fall back to trade-flow+L1 and LABEL it. Weak data must never create false precision.

9 SCORING = score blind vs refined SEPARATELY; direction alone insufficient - measure magnitude, path, onset, turns, MFE, MAE, trend-vs-chop, confidence calibration. Distinguishes genuine improvement from merely REACTING after the move.
10 LESSON PROPOSALS = propose mechanisms with supporting events, counterexamples, scope, n, confidence, forward validation. Never auto-rewrite the brain.
refinement_architecture_s103.goal: Preserve what the old framework did well; use the new data to improve TIMING, MAGNITUDE, TURNS, and CONFIDENCE - not to replace it.

ALIGNED delivers the band; NEGATIVE-under-rising = absorption/covering -> reversal/round-trip. This ONE derived feature does the discrimination that onset_dir / absorb-flag / print-direction CANNOT (those were identical on 0319 and 0326 yet resolved oppositely).
mbo_refinement_g15_findings.direction_source_rule: Direction stays with the D-1 trade tilt (prior-session big_print_b_share / session_b_share) that the blind already consumes. Gate 1-min imb_flow OUT of the direction decision entirely; use MBO only for TURN and ABSORPTION confirmation. imb_flow flips faster than its own autocorrelation at 30-min grain - a sampling artifact, not signal.
mbo_refinement_g15_findings.anticipation_vs_confirmation: The 0318 anticipatory signal (bid-level build near the low) was already in the D-1 trades the open-conditions blind saw. MBO's honest role on 0318 was CONFIRMATION, not anticipation. Scored as improved-vs-reacted: the turn magnitude tail (+1900 actual) was partly reactive; the confirmed base was +1500.
engine_change_requests: Emit ONE session-level data-quality verdict (book_trustworthy bit = execution_authority AND conviction>=floor AND book_complete) + only material transition bars, NOT 150+ repeated stand-down rows.
Phase-first not tick-first: feed the specialist the phase table + session turns as the PRIMARY object; demote the minute-grain series to a diagnostic.
Print-anchored windows on EIA-Thu: reset phases at the 10:30 ET print (pre-print / delivery / post-delivery), not volume-based boundaries that straddle the print.

Roll seam as a first-class engine object: a leg_map (raw_symbol per date, NGJ26 pre-roll / NGK26 post-roll, not NG.n.0) + an explicit seam_event traded=false so overnight_gap is forced to 0 and the offset is scoring-only.

he24_to_he1_handoff_spec.principle: The day-boundary handoff carries STATE, never the day-net number. Each specialist starts from the prior day's MARKET CONDITION so the block is one continuous path, not siloed guesses.
he24_to_he1_handoff_spec.carried_state: close price + last-hour direction; running chain polarity + age (sessions since last turn); cum-from-anchor vs nearest origin shelf; exhaustion-state flag (absorption building / climax printed / turn confirmed-or-pending); flow-conviction verdict; data-quality state (was the read trade-flow-only?); any armed C1 flip-watch (never front-run); spent-vs-unrealized-ahead driver tag.
he24_to_he1_handoff_spec.turn_ownership: A turn firing in the overnight HE24->HE1 seam belongs to the boundary: whoever owns the day the turn REALIZES into inherits it, but sizes it using the PRIOR day's exhaustion-state flag (so 0318 doesn't compound a possibly-overshot tail).
he24_to_he1_handoff_spec.weekend_seam: Sunday inherits the Friday CLOSE + chain state, not the Friday day-move; the overnight gap SIGN is a non-derivable handoff (forecast the day-move from the anchor, treat the reopen gap as noise). Spent-vs-unrealized-ahead is the gap-ownership key: crest-trim -> Sunday can gap-fade; covering/holding -> Sunday reopen likely continues the bid. A weekend that also carries a contract roll passes the leg change as never-traded.

The 07-10 ET catch-up window reprices driver_realization: a driver that realized over the weekend makes the catch-up a FADE (sell-the-news), not an extend.

midweek_exit_read_protocol.purpose: The standardized EXIT read a mid-week specialist HANDS FORWARD (D/E and the Monday fix consume it). It is STATE, never the day-net. Emit at every mid-week close.

fields.last_hour_dir: sign of the final-2h cum change (curve_2h[-1]-curve_2h[-2]): did the turn begin AT the boundary? gates next-day magnitude (magnitude_gate)
fields.close_off_extreme: coff: closed AT the high (>=0.95) / AT the low (<=0.05) = STRETCHED -> give-back inheritance; 0.3-0.7 = balanced
fields.run_size_and_stretched_flag: the day's one-session move; stretched = run>=~1200 AND coff at extreme
fields.chain_polarity_and_age: down/up and sessions since the turn - gates young-extends-vs-mature-gives-back (R4) and reversal-recognition (age>=3)
fields.exhaustion_state: D-1/own-day absorption (large signed flow, price holds) or big-print climax at the extreme = reversal primed; none = chain intact
fields.conviction_verdict: flow_conviction = sign(signed_flow)*sign(price_change): ALIGNED = trend healthy; NEGATIVE-under-rising = absorption/covering = turn risk
fields.what_next_day_inherits: the explicit instruction: EXTEND vs EXPECT-GIVE-BACK vs REVERSAL-PRIMED-DO-NOT-FRONT-RUN

the_three_inheritance_verdicts: STRETCHED-EXTREME CLOSE (coff>=0.95, run>=1200, chain age>=2) -> next day STOP EXTENDING, expect a capped give-back (midweek.stretched_extreme_close_giveback).

MATURE-DOWN-CHAIN AT SHELF/EXTREME + D-1 EXHAUSTION TELL -> next day REVERSAL UP primed; the turn realizes post-open if this day exited DOWN, so size the confirmed shelf-retrace base and DO NOT front-run the tail (recognition + magnitude_gate).
YOUNG CHAIN-SIDED EXTENSION (age 0-1, aligned flow) -> next day CARRIES the chain at FULL band; void the give-back inheritance for one more session (young_chain_extension_full_band).

data_doctrine_kitchen_sink_s105.rule: BOTH agents get EVERYTHING - the kitchen sink - to choose from. The blind's ONE and ONLY deliberate mask is the PRICE CURVE (settles, nets, day-moves, levels, spreads, and the target-day+ price path it forecasts). Everything else - all fundamentals/structure/calendar/positioning/COT/weather/storage AND the FULL MBO order-flow read (signed-flow imbalance, UNBALANCED SIDES = buy-vs-sell aggressor, absorption/divergence) of every decision-legit window (prior sessions in full + the current day's pre-decision reopen/overnight flow for a rolling daily forecast) - the blind gets in FULL.
data_doctrine_kitchen_sink_s105.why: Greg, stated repeatedly: we are NOT tricking or handicapping the blind or making it harder. Masking ONLY the price curve is how he LEARNS - denied the answer (price), he must build the forecast from the underlying MARKET FORCES themselves (order-flow imbalance + unbalanced sides, positioning/COT extremity, absorption/divergence, fundamentals, weather, storage, structure, the futures->Kalshi lead). Read the price and he learns nothing; read the forces and he SHARPENS his mastery of every one. That mastery is the edge and is what makes him a better FORWARD-CURVE BUILDER (the whole product). So give him every market force in full; withhold only the price he exists to predict. Feeding only reduced tape_conditions and forbidding dip_imb_level was hamstringing him - repealed.
data_doctrine_kitchen_sink_s105.dip_imb_level: USABLE on decision-legit windows (prior sessions + current-day pre-decision flow). The old blanket 'forbidden in the blind prior' is REPEALED. Only the FUTURE (a window not yet traded at the decision horizon) is off-limits - causality, not a mask.

The MBO said sell-imbalanced all day. Had the blind seen this it would NOT have over-sized 0420 to -400 (actual -60). THIS is why the blind needs the flow read.
data_doctrine_kitchen_sink_s105.process_discipline: Stage ALL groups' DATA turnkey-ready (legs/state/actual/mbo-evidence), but RUN one group (2 weeks) at a time - finish its full cycle before the next. Running ahead is scope creep.
